title: Eccolo, Almidano Artifoni said in friendly haste. Venga a trovarmi e ci pensi. Addio, caro.
html_source: Italian: “There it is. Think about it and come and see me. Goodbye my friend.”

anchor.text: Eccolo, Almidano Artifoni said in friendly haste. Venga a trovarmi e ci pensi. Addio, caro.
anchor.prefix:
— Ma, sul serio, eh? Almidano Artifoni said. 

 His heavy hand took Stephen's firmly. Human eyes. They gazed curiously an instant and turned quickly towards a Dalkey tram. 

—
anchor.suffix:
1961#228

 — Arrivederla, maestro, Stephen said, raising his hat when his hand was freed. E grazie. 

1922#219

 — Di che? Almidano Artifoni said. Scusi, eh? Tante belle cose!
